class ReachesEarly {
  value: number;
  constructor(flag: boolean) {
    if (flag) return;
    this.value = 1;
    return;
    return;
  }
}
class FinalizerCanReturn {
  value: number;
  constructor(flag: boolean) {
    try { return; }
    finally {
      if (flag) return;
      this.value = 2;
    }
  }
}
